$Comment: The Voidtaken Horseman, the restless graveyard's boss wave. The run's script (Seasons_Of_Orbis_Restless_Graveyard_Encounter) names this group in its Groups, so a boss wave stands until he falls and he is cleared away with the rest when the run ends. ZigRank Boss counts him as a boss for CommonLib's crowd-control rule (a CommonLib without that rule ignores the tag): a talent's stun, root, slow or push never lands on him, an ability's own does, and a taunt always does. Add a role id here, written *<id>, if he gains another form. Each role id is written after a * the way the game's own groups write *Chicken: the star still matches that role, while the game works a group out again as each mod's roles load, before this pack's own, so a bare id would log a warning at every server start though the group comes out the same.
